title: Live and in the studio
notes: New live mini game, Work the crowd: a full-screen 3D concert where you hit the beat, get the crowd clapping, hold the mic out for a sing-along and choose big moments (the high note, the catwalk, the story behind the song). A crowd hype meter decides your score, and a hyped crowd gives you an encore. Choose it on the pre-show screen; the rhythm game is still there too.

A real recording studio in 3D: a control room with a mixing desk, monitors, the vocal booth window and a red RECORDING light. You see it at every step of a session: picking the producer, the band in the live room, you singing in the booth and the overdubs with your producer.
The producer talks back after every take, a live waveform shows how close you are, and a short cutscene plays before each playback.
